### Devotional: Leviticus 18
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-18-psalm-22-ecclesiastes-1-1-timothy-3/
Passage: Leviticus 18:1-30
Points:
- Moral prohibitions existed prior to Sinai because aspects of God's law are imprinted on the human conscience.
- The sexual and moral commands are grounded directly in God's holy character and covenant relationship with Israel.
- The prohibitions against incest, perverse sexual acts, and child sacrifice protect the sanctity and integrity of the family.
- God warned Israel that adopting the corrupt practices of surrounding pagan nations would lead to defilement and expulsion from the land.
- The legal covenant's foundational principle is demand, contrasting with the new covenant which centers upon saving faith.
